languageGate.title: Choose language
languageGate.subtitle: Select the interface language for this demo workspace.
languageGate.note: You can switch language later in the header.

appShell.sideNote: Portfolio MVP for AI-assisted campaign launch readiness. It does not accept payments, customer data, production credentials, or live campaign traffic.
appShell.mobileNotice: Portfolio MVP workspace. Use the page controls below for route navigation on larger screens.

welcome.headline: Promo Preflight
welcome.subhead: AI-assisted launch readiness for regulated promotional campaigns.
welcome.body: Review promo bundles before launch across copy, terms, locale, links, owners and launch blockers.
welcome.handoffCopy: Promo quality usually breaks at handoff points: terms, CRM, localization, legal, product and analytics.
welcome.coordinationCopy: Launch readiness is a coordination problem before it becomes a product problem.

steps.title: Promo Preflight in 90 seconds
steps.description: This desktop tour uses a regulated promo sample to show intake, checks, readiness, rules, owners, and version history.

steps.title: BR welcome sample loaded
steps.description: The intake now contains a synthetic BR welcome sample with campaign metadata, terms, channel copy, links, and owners.

steps.title: Run Preflight
steps.description: The existing runner turns the loaded sample into exactly 8 deterministic check results.

steps.title: Risk Report summary
steps.description: The report rolls the sample into status counts, blockers, and copy-ready export controls.

steps.title: Eight check cards
steps.description: Each card keeps the public check name, status, severity, issue count, and confidence visible for reviewers.

steps.title: Evidence and suggested fix
steps.description: Selecting an issue shows source fields, short evidence, owner suggestion, and the operational fix to request.

steps.title: Export controls
steps.description: The report can be copied as Markdown or Slack-ready text without including the full raw terms by default.

steps.title: Launch Readiness
steps.description: FAIL issues become blockers and WARN issues become owner review dependencies for go/no-go handoff.

steps.title: Rules are visible
steps.description: The YAML rules artifact is shown for review visibility; runtime behavior still comes from the TypeScript checks.

steps.title: Owners come from config
steps.description: Readiness and version views resolve owner names from workspace config and campaign-level overrides.

steps.title: Campaign versioning
steps.description: A sample version history shows how repeated runs are stored as extracted facts and blocker summaries.

steps.title: Version diff
steps.description: The diff highlights blockers that are new, still open, reopened, or resolved between two sample runs.

issueDetail.title: Issue detail
issueDetail.whyBlocker: This is marked as a blocker because the campaign should not move into launch readiness until the owner resolves or explicitly accepts the risk.
issueDetail.whyHighSeverity: This needs owner review because it can affect approval, handoff clarity, or post-launch issue handling.
issueDetail.whyDefault: This should be cleaned up before handoff so launch owners have clear, traceable actions.

empty.description: Issue explanation, affected source fields, suggested fix, and owner assignment will appear here.

readiness.title: Owners, blockers, dependencies
readiness.subtitle: Live readiness board for {campaignName}, generated from the current schema-valid Risk Report and owner data.
readiness.savedReportInvalid: Saved report data is invalid, so readiness was generated from the deterministic offline sample.
readiness.schemaInvalid: Generated readiness did not match the schema, so the offline sample is shown.

stateDescriptions.ready: No FAIL or WARN checks are present in the linked Risk Report.
stateDescriptions.readyWithWarnings: No FAIL checks are present, but owner review dependencies remain.
stateDescriptions.blocked: At least one critical or high severity blocker must be resolved before launch handoff.
stateDescriptions.needsReview: Parsing uncertainty or low confidence on a core check requires manual review before go/no-go.

blockers.title: Blockers
blockers.emptyDescription: FAIL issues and missing Legal or Risk owners will appear here.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
